pages.title: 仪表盘
pages.visualNorthStar: Data-driven command center with KPI summary cards, trend charts, recent waybill/bill lists, and financial overview — all on one screen
pages.compositionPattern: Large/medium/small stacked: top KPI row, middle charts + lists, bottom recent activity

pages.title: 运单管理
pages.visualNorthStar: High-density waybill list with status filters, search, batch operations, and status flow indicators — logistics control table
pages.compositionPattern: Filter bar on top, dense data table below with status badges and row actions

pages.title: 创建运单
pages.visualNorthStar: Multi-section form for creating a waybill: sender info, receiver info, cargo details, service options — clean and operable
pages.compositionPattern: Sectioned form layout with left labels and right inputs, sticky action bar at bottom

pages.title: 提单管理
pages.visualNorthStar: Bill of lading list with booking status flow, customs/clearance tracking, and financial linkage — freight management table
pages.compositionPattern: Status flow tabs on top, dense data table with status pipeline indicators and row actions

pages.title: 创建提单
pages.visualNorthStar: Multi-section form for creating a bill of lading: booking info, vessel/voyage, cargo details, container info, customs — structured and operable
pages.compositionPattern: Sectioned form with grouped fields, sticky action bar at bottom

pages.title: 应收报表
pages.visualNorthStar: Accounts receivable financial report with summary KPIs, aging analysis, customer breakdown, and detailed transaction table — finance dashboard
pages.compositionPattern: KPI summary row on top, aging chart + customer breakdown in middle, detailed transaction table at bottom
componentPlan: aging analysis bar chart via Chart.js

pages.title: 应付报表
pages.visualNorthStar: Accounts payable financial report with summary KPIs, payment schedule, supplier breakdown, and detailed cost table — cost control dashboard
pages.compositionPattern: KPI summary row on top, payment timeline + supplier breakdown in middle, detailed cost table at bottom
